answer: Audits are recorded in tide, queued in nebula, and mesa publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 45 identities per epoch. A farm of 287 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2831 identities would post 668 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
